name: still-air
description: Still Air: NASA Space Apps project. Flames in still air, from orbit to the Moon.

scripts.build: npm run build-info && npm run build -w proof && npm run build-envelope && npm run build-psi-conditions && npm run build-facts && npm run build-ask-index && npm run build-eval-summary && tsc -p api --noEmit && npm run build -w web && node scripts/check-no-mock.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build-info && npm run build -w proof && npm run build-envelope && npm run build-facts && npm run build-ask-index && npm run build-eval-summary && vitest run
scripts.validate: npm run build -w proof --silent && node scripts/validate-data.mjs
scripts.build-investigations: npm run build -w proof --silent && node scripts/build-investigations.mjs
